items.text: Strip Away the Title Strip Strip Away the Title Strip away the title and HR's core job is this: you make decisions about people, who gets hired, who gets paid what, who gets trained, who gets let go, and how the company treats all of them along the way, and you have to defend those decisions to people who often disagree with you.

rows: Typical range for an HR Executive or Recruiter role at most Indian companies. Staffing and consulting firms often sit at the lower end of this band; product companies and GCCs pay closer to the top.
HR Generalist territory, once you can run a full recruitment cycle, onboarding process, or basic engagement calendar without close supervision.

HRBP band. National average sits around Rs 12.5 LPA, with the middle 50% of HRBPs earning between roughly Rs 8.2-20.3 LPA depending on company size, sector, and city. Bangalore HRBPs average about 21% above the national figure.

HR Manager to HR Director band. AmbitionBox places typical HR Manager pay around Rs 8-18 LPA broadly, with strong performers at larger organisations crossing Rs 19 LPA well before Director-level titles.
